paragraphs: Yochai: Rabbi Yaakov was his son; there is also Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai. [Glosses: Yochi. In tractate Kallah: ‘Rabbi Yochi bar Yoshiyah’; perhaps it should read ‘Achi.’ In the new Talmud edition: ‘Rabbi Yochi bar Yoshiyahu.’]
